intro: Moscow rewards visitors with grand history, world-class art, and a fast, cheap metro. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro is fast, cheap and runs about 05:30-01:00; stations are attractions in themselves.
Buses, trolleybuses and trams fill the gaps; a Troika card cuts fares.
Yandex Go is the main ride app; taxis are metered but agree the price first.
Driving in the centre is slow and parking is costly; use park-and-ride.
Central streets are walkable; bike lanes are limited and winter is icy.
No useful ferry service in the city.

red_square.name: Red Square
red_square.hours: Open 24 hours; closed to cars. Check for event closures.
red_square.tip: Come early morning or after dark for fewer crowds and good photos.

kremlin.name: Moscow Kremlin
kremlin.price_text: ≈ RUB 1000 for the grounds; cathedrals and Armoury cost extra. Check on the day.
kremlin.hours: Closed Thursday. Usually 10:00–17:00; check on the day.
kremlin.tip: Buy tickets online in advance and bring your passport.

st_basil.name: St. Basil's Cathedral
st_basil.price_text: ≈ RUB 1000 entry; check on the day
st_basil.hours: Usually 10:00–18:00, closed some days in winter; check on the day.
st_basil.tip: The outside is free and the best view is from the square's south end.

lenin.name: Lenin's Mausoleum
lenin.hours: Usually Tue–Sat 10:00–13:00; often closed Monday and Sunday. Check on the day.
lenin.tip: Expect a security queue; no bags, phones or photos inside.

metro.name: Moscow Metro Stations
metro.price_text: ≈ RUB 60 per ride; day passes available
metro.tip: Ride the circle line and stop at Komsomolskaya, Novoslobodskaya and Belorusskaya for the best halls.

tretyakov.name: Tretyakov Gallery
tretyakov.hours: Closed Monday. Usually 10:00–18:00, later some days.
tretyakov.tip: Focus on the main building for Russian art; the Vrubel hall is a highlight.

christ_saviour.name: Cathedral of Christ the Saviour
christ_saviour.price_text: Free to enter; small fee for the viewing platform
christ_saviour.tip: Dress modestly and walk the Patriarch Bridge for the best photo of the cathedral.

gum.name: GUM
gum.price_text: Free to enter; shops and cafes priced separately
gum.tip: Go for the glass roof and ice cream; window shopping is fine.

bolshoi.name: Bolshoi Theatre
bolshoi.price_text: ≈ RUB 1500–10000 depending on seat and show
bolshoi.hours: Box office usually 11:00–19:00; performances in the evening
bolshoi.tip: Book ballet or opera weeks ahead online; the historic stage is the one to see.

novodevichy.name: Novodevichy Convent
novodevichy.price_text: ≈ RUB 300–500 for museums; grounds may be free. Check on the day.
novodevichy.hours: Usually 09:00–17:00; some buildings closed certain days
novodevichy.tip: Pair it with the nearby cemetery, where many famous Russians are buried.

sparrow_hills.name: Sparrow Hills
sparrow_hills.tip: Best city panorama; ride the cable car or walk down to the river.

hist_museum.name: State Historical Museum
hist_museum.tip: Good rainy-day stop right on Red Square; allow two hours.

vdnkh.name: VDNKh
vdnkh.price_text: Free to enter; some pavilions and rides cost extra
vdnkh.tip: Huge Soviet-era park; rent a bike or take the free shuttle to cover ground.

kolomenskoye.name: Kolomenskoye Estate
kolomenskoye.price_text: Free grounds; small fees for some buildings
kolomenskoye.tip: Walk to the white Church of the Ascension and the wooden palace area.

attractionmania.name: Attractionmania
attractionmania.price_text: Price varies by attraction; check on the day
attractionmania.tip: Confirm location and opening hours before you go; details change.

blue_dancers.name: Blue Dancers
blue_dancers.price_text: Included in Tretyakov Gallery ticket (≈ RUB 700–900)
blue_dancers.tip: This is a painting by Degas in the Tretyakov; ask staff which room.

borscht.name: Borscht (classic Russian soup)
borscht.price_text: ≈ RUB 350–700 a bowl at a sit-down cafe
borscht.tip: Order it with sour cream and dark bread; try a well-known canteen for a cheap version.

dodo_pizza.name: Dodo Pizza
dodo_pizza.tip: Reliable budget chain with English menus; good for a quick family meal.

dream_island.name: Dream Island
dream_island.price_text: ≈ RUB 2000–3500 day pass; check on the day
dream_island.tip: Indoor theme park; buy tickets online and go on a weekday to avoid queues.

gorky_park.name: Gorky Park, Moscow
gorky_park.price_text: Free to enter; rentals and cafes extra
gorky_park.tip: Rent a bike or skate and follow the river embankment; lively in summer.

kazansky.name: Kazansky Cathedral
kazansky.tip: Small active church on Red Square; step in briefly and dress modestly.

luzhniki.name: Luzhniki Stadium
luzhniki.price_text: Tours and events priced separately; check on the day
luzhniki.hours: Check on the day; event days vary
luzhniki.tip: Check the fixture list; a match or concert is the best reason to visit.

danilovsky_market.name: Danilovsky Market
danilovsky_market.price_text: Meals ≈ RUB 500–1200; produce priced per item
danilovsky_market.tip: Food hall plus fresh produce; go hungry and try a few stalls.

arbat_walk.name: Arbat Street walk
arbat_walk.tip: Pedestrian street with cafes and street art; wander the side lanes for quieter spots.

river_cruise.name: Moskva River boat cruise
river_cruise.price_text: ≈ RUB 700–1500 for a 1-hour cruise; check on the day
river_cruise.tip: Book a sunset departure near the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour for the best views.

patriarch_ponds.name: Patriarch Ponds walk
patriarch_ponds.tip: Leafy pond-side stroll with cafes; a relaxed break from the big sights.

zaryadye.name: Zaryadye Park
zaryadye.tip: Walk the floating bridge over the river for a free view of the Kremlin.

stays.why: Central and walkable. Close to Red Square, the Bolshoi and good restaurants. Metro everywhere.
Steps from Red Square and the Kremlin. Quiet lanes, easy metro links.
Lively pedestrian street, cafés and shops. Walk to the Kremlin in about 20 minutes.
Quieter, greener area near the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour and Gorky Park.

food: Try Russian classics: borscht, pelmeni dumplings, blini and syrniki pancakes.
Look for stolovaya canteens for cheap, filling lunches; prices vary, check the day's menu.
Georgian food is everywhere and good: khachapuri bread and khinkali dumplings.
Coffee and pastry culture is strong in the centre; many cafés open early.
Book popular restaurants ahead for weekend evenings. Tipping of about 10% is common.
more_time: Add a day for a country estate or monastery outside the centre; check opening days and transport first.
Art lovers can swap a museum for a gallery afternoon in the former factory districts.
In warm months, spend an evening on a river cruise or a walk in Gorky Park.
